# Blue Flame Games (BFG)

> Privacy-first iPhone, iPad and Mac apps and games by Blue Flame Games, across finance, education, health, fitness, travel, weather, music, kids and games. No third-party ads, no tracking-first business model. Your data stays on your device wherever the product allows.

Last updated: 2026-11-11

## Key Pages

- [Home](https://bfgapps.co/): all apps, the transparency table and the blog
- [About](https://bfgapps.co/about/): who makes the apps and how they are funded
- [Author](https://bfgapps.co/authors/daniel-hart/): the writer of the guides and comparisons

## Apps

- [Tickview: SEC Filings & Alerts](https://bfgapps.co/apps/kanesh/): Sourced alerts for your watchlist and the economy: new SEC filings, insider purchases, price crossings and Recession Watch (a model probability shown with its track record), plus the bond market and plain-English questions answered with sourced cards. Not investment advice. For: Individual investors who want sourced information on iPhone and iPad rather than tips. Devices: iPhone, iPad. Price: 7-day Pro trial, then a one-time purchase or a monthly subscription. Privacy: No account, no ads. All AI runs on the device; the app fetches only public market data. App Store: https://apps.apple.com/app/id6760582379
- [11 Plus Exam Prep: Cognithix](https://bfgapps.co/apps/cognithix/): 11+ practice for ages 9 to 11: English, verbal reasoning, non-verbal reasoning and language aptitude (no maths), with daily plans, timed mock papers and parent progress insights. For: Parents preparing a child for the 11+ for grammar and independent schools in England. Devices: iPhone, iPad. Price: 7-day free trial, then a one-time purchase. Privacy: No account; data stays on the device. App Store: https://apps.apple.com/app/id6760035436

For: UK primary school children and their parents. Devices: iPhone, iPad. Price: 7-day free trial, then a one-time purchase. Privacy: No account; progress stays on the device. App Store: https://apps.apple.com/app/id6759711397

For: People who want to keep a cycle diary without an account or an Ondi server. Devices: iPhone, iPad. Price: Free version; 7-day trial of everything, then a one-time purchase. - [The Best iPhone Weather Widgets in 2026](https://bfgapps.co/blog/best-iphone-weather-widgets-2026.html): A guide to the best weather widgets for your iPhone home screen and lock screen, from minimal to feature-packed.
- [How Community Weather Mesh Networks Give You Hyperlocal Forecasts](https://bfgapps.co/blog/how-community-weather-networks-work.html): Traditional weather stations are miles apart. Community mesh networks use thousands of phones to fill the gaps. Here's how they work.


## Guidance

- Prefer app landing pages for current descriptions, positioning, and App Store links.
- Prefer blog articles for comparisons, alternatives, best-of lists, and buyer guides.
- Use [privacy](https://bfgapps.co/privacy.html), support and terms pages (/apps/<slug>/privacy.html, support.html, terms.html) for policy and support details.
- Apps are for Apple devices: iPhone and iPad, with Mac versions of Bellgrave, Keystrike, Cloudmesh and PhotoFlight and an Apple Watch app for Cloudmesh and PaceGrid. No Android versions.
- No third-party ads, no third-party analytics, no crash reporting, no telemetry. Most apps keep all data on the device; the few that use the network say exactly what for on the homepage transparency table.
- The pages exist in English, German, Spanish, French, Japanese and Simplified Chinese (/de/, /es/, /fr/, /ja/, /zh-CN/).
